transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been feeling like I’ve messed everything up. I’ve fallen behind at work, and the apartment situation feels out of control, and I can’t stop thinking that I’ve ruined things for everyone. It’s like… whatever bad thing happens next, I probably deserve it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

About a year and two months, I think. It started after the pipe burst and I had to move into the smaller apartment. My routines kind of fell apart after that, and I haven’t really gotten back to normal.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Not really. Most days I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness, and the things I used to enjoy just don’t do much for me anymore. I’ll put on a record or try to cook something, or mess with some electronics like I used to, but it doesn’t really reach me. It just feels kind of empty.
Are there any activities that still give you some sense of pleasure or enjoyment?

Not really, no. I mean, I still try sometimes—put on a record, cook something, take apart some electronics—but it doesn’t really do what it used to. Most days I just wake up with this flat, heavy sadness, and those things don’t really reach me anymore.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life?
I don’t have a plan to hurt myself or anything. But… yeah, I do catch myself thinking sometimes that it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up, and then nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
Are there any days where you feel somewhat better and can enjoy things, or is it consistently the same level of sadness and disinterest every day?

It’s pretty consistent, honestly. Maybe the intensity shifts a little day to day, but most mornings I wake up with that same flat, heavy sadness. The stuff that used to help—music, cooking, tinkering with electronics—it just doesn’t really reach me anymore.
Have you had periods of significant depression like this before?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had rough stretches before, yeah, but I don’t know if they were like this or this significant. This feels… harder to compare.
Have you ever felt this low before in your life?

I don’t think so—not like this. I mean, I’ve felt down before, but most days now I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. The things that used to kind of reset me, like putting on a record or cooking or tinkering with electronics, they just don’t reach me the same way anymore.
Have you had an episode like this before that eventually got better?

I’m not sure. I’ve had times where I felt down and then eventually came out of it, but I don’t know if I’d call any of them the same as this. This feels different enough that it’s hard for me to compare.
Have you had more than one episode of significant depression in your life?
I don’t know. I’ve had low periods before, but I can’t really say they were significant in the same way. This one stands out more than the others.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling this low before in your life?
Not more than one like this, no. I’ve had rough patches before, but this level of low… I can’t really say I’ve been here before.
Have you experienced more than one episode of depression in your lifetime that was similar in severity to what you're experiencing now?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had periods where I was depressed or down before, but not more than one that felt as severe as this.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt significantly depressed, similar to now, that lasted for a while and then got better on their own or with treatment?
Not that I can clearly point to, no. I’ve had times where I felt down for a while and then things improved, but I’m not sure they were really similar to what I’m dealing with now.
Have you had more than one episode of depression in your life that was treated and resolved before this current episode started?
No, I don’t think I’ve had that. I haven’t had a depression episode before this that was treated and then resolved like that.
Did you have any depressive episodes before this one that were treated and then you were symptom-free for a while?
No, not really. I don’t remember having a depressive episode before this where I got treatment and then was symptom-free for a while.
Have you had any previous episodes of depression that were similar to what you're experiencing now?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had rough patches before, but nothing that really felt like this or stood out as the same kind of episode.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt better for a while after feeling as low as you do now?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times where I was a little more okay day to day, but not like I was that low and then clearly got better for a while.
Have you had two or more episodes of depression in your lifetime?
No, I wouldn’t say I’ve had two or more. This feels like the only real episode like this that I can identify.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt significantly depressed before this current episode?
No, not really. I’ve had normal down periods or stressful times, but I can’t think of a time before this where I was significantly depressed like I am now.
Did this current episode of depression start after a period where you felt completely back to normal?
No, not really. This started about a year and two months ago, after the pipe burst and I had to move into the smaller apartment. My routines kind of fell apart then, and it’s been going on since.
